newsitem.title: GERMANY: Arthuis sees 1997 growth above 2.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Arthuis sees 1997 growth above 2.3 pct.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Saturday that growth in 1997 should be above the 2.3 percent officially forecast by the government in its budget bill.

A range of factors, including the recent rise in the dollar, would help French growth this year, he told a news conference after a meeting here of Group of Seven finance ministers and central bankers.
"The 2.3 percent must be considered as a floor," Arthuis said. "Growth should be more than 2.3 percent."
He also repeated that 1996 growth should be 1.3 percent, the level forecast in the 1996 budget bill.
